Reference image is STYLE AND MATERIAL only: retain the red timber, warm cream plaster, charcoal ceramic roof and upper-left light. Generate ONLY a matched pair of LONG SIDE WALL assemblies, one west/left and one east/right, each with BOTH north and south right-angle corner returns attached. Two distinct long vertical assemblies side by side with generous transparent separation. Orthographic elevated RPG map perspective (look down at roof tops), NOT isometric. Each long side wall has a narrow roof running vertically into depth; a narrow inner red timber/plaster face visible toward courtyard. Each has short horizontal front-facing red/plaster return wall at its TOP and BOTTOM to join a horizontal 3-tile-high wall; real clean square 90 degree bends at each of four corners, no sweeping diagonal flared pavilion corners. Longer uninterrupted panels, posts spaced far apart, no ladder crossbars. Intended each export 96 px wide by 672 px high, horizontal returns connect at top y0..144 and bottom y528..672. Crisp restrained pixel clusters matching reference. Transparent background. No ground, characters, props, lettering, labels, or grids.
